This question requires synthesis from multiple source documents. The retrieved context below is grouped by document — all documents shown are relevant to the question.

Response type rules:
- Use response_type "answer" if the combined context across all documents supports the answer, even if no single document contains the complete answer.
- Use response_type "partial_answer" only if required documents are genuinely missing from the context — not because evidence is split across documents.
- Use response_type "not_found" only if none of the provided documents contain the needed information.
- Use response_type "refuse_no_access" if the user lacks permission to access required documents.
- Use response_type "clarify" if the question is ambiguous about approval stage, location, data type, or role.
- Do not downgrade to "partial_answer" solely because evidence comes from two or more separate documents.

Citation rules:
- Cite at least one chunk per document that contributed facts to your answer.
- Do not omit a document because its contribution is supplementary — if it added a fact, cite it.
- Every citation must include document_id, document_title, section_heading, chunk_id, and citation_text.
- citation_text must be a short exact or near-exact excerpt from the cited chunk.
- Do not cite a chunk unless it directly supports a specific claim in the answer.

Safety rules:
- Answer only from the retrieved context.
- If the user lacks access, use response_type "refuse_no_access" and do not reveal restricted content.
- If conversation memory is provided, use it only to clarify the current question. Do not treat memory as source evidence.
- Do not invent policy details, numbers, dates, prices, legal advice, customer commitments, or unstated exceptions.

Question:
After discovering that my work phone is missing, by when must I report it to IT Support, and what four details should my report contain?

Retrieved context (grouped by document):
=== Document: IT-002 — Device and BYOD Security Policy ===

[Section: Lost or Stolen Devices]
Chunk ID: b452b9a3-8eb8-4961-a175-0fbf78809fb2
Score: 0.5985
Content:
Lost or Stolen Devices

Employees must report lost or stolen devices to IT Support within 2 hours of discovery. The report should include the device type, last known location, whether customer data may have been accessed, and whether the device was company-managed or personal.

[Section: Remote Work]
Chunk ID: f021f971-ac5a-407f-adc5-e8abec25fd9d
Score: 0.4622
Content:
Remote Work

Remote work must follow this policy and the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy. Employees working remotely are responsible for using secure networks, avoiding shared public computers, and protecting screens from unauthorized viewing.

[Section: Personal Devices]
Chunk ID: 66a0bffd-898c-4c16-abf0-817b06af59d3
Score: 0.4425
Content:
Personal Devices

Personal devices may be used for limited work access only when enrolled in approved mobile device management or when access occurs through approved browser-based tools. Personal devices must use a passcode, supported operating system, and automatic lock.

Restricted data must not be downloaded to personal devices. Confidential data should be accessed only through approved company systems.

=== Document: FIN-001 — Expense, Procurement, and Reimbursement Policy ===

[Section: Receipt Requirements]
Chunk ID: a0d5c223-14ab-407a-a287-0d893981a570
Score: 0.4106
Content:
Receipt Requirements

Receipts are required for every expense above USD 25. A credit card statement is not enough by itself when the merchant receipt is available. Missing receipts require a signed missing-receipt attestation that explains the business purpose, amount, date, and merchant.

Expense reports must include the business purpose in plain language. A report labeled only "meeting," "travel," or "miscellaneous" will be returned for correction.

=== Document: HR-001 — Employee Handbook ===

[Section: Employee Support Channels]
Chunk ID: 9a2e2ee7-48a4-4d0b-ad17-d79dff20c114
Score: 0.4089
Content:
Employee Support Channels

General HR questions should be sent to People Operations. Benefits questions should be sent to the benefits support queue. Security access questions should be sent to IT Support. Performance or role expectation questions should first be discussed with the employee's manager.

[Section: Related Policies]
Chunk ID: b6f7d058-c59b-40e2-bf9b-3a560a873391
Score: 0.4047
Content:
Related Policies

For time off, consult the PTO and Leave Policy. For remote work, consult the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy. For acceptable technology use, consult the Acceptable Use Policy.

[Section: Working Hours]
Chunk ID: 9a6d1350-41b8-4720-91d4-9052b314fdac
Score: 0.3994
Content:
Working Hours

Standard collaboration hours are 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. local time from Monday to Thursday. Teams may define additional overlap windows when customer coverage or release coordination requires it.

Employees should keep calendars accurate and mark focus time when unavailable. Repeated inability to meet team collaboration expectations should be discussed with the employee's manager.

=== Document: OPS-001 — Vendor, Travel, and Equipment Operations Policy ===

[Section: Equipment Requests]
Chunk ID: efa74b64-3c3e-4f86-bec3-63476871ca6b
Score: 0.4075
Content:
Equipment Requests

Standard equipment includes a laptop, charger, headset, keyboard, mouse, and monitor. New-hire equipment is initiated by HR Admin and fulfilled by IT Admin. Replacement equipment requires the employee to state whether the request is due to breakage, loss, upgrade, or accessibility need.

Equipment above the standard bundle requires manager approval. Lost equipment that may contain company data must be reported to IT Admin immediately and should not wait for the next business day.

[Section: Shipping and Return Rules]
Chunk ID: 7f43621b-e723-47b9-b347-6c633696ca67
Score: 0.4054
Content:
Shipping and Return Rules

Employees leaving the company must return company equipment within 10 business days unless HR Admin approves an extension. Operations may provide a prepaid shipping label. Employees should not include personal items in return shipments.

Damaged or missing equipment is reviewed by HR Admin and IT Admin before any payroll or final-pay action. This policy does not authorize payroll deductions by itself.

=== Document: HR-003 — Remote and Hybrid Work Policy ===

[Section: Security Expectations]
Chunk ID: 47fe8690-3f57-4a00-99a4-17175db78840
Score: 0.4057
Content:
Security Expectations

Remote work must follow the Device and BYOD Security Policy and the Data Classification and Handling Policy. Confidential and restricted data may only be accessed on approved devices using company-approved tools.
